name: They Who Play With Sacred Things
source:
Based on a forgotten 1927 story, this game explores what happens when a murder trial extends beyond life itself.

[From [url=https://thelateknight.itch.io/they-who-play-with-sacred-things]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该游戏基于一个被遗忘的1927年故事，探索当谋杀案审判延伸到生活本身之外时会发生什么。

[来自[url=https://thelateknight.itch.io/they-who-play-with-sacred-things]Itch.io[/url]]
